title: Hazardous materials placard
description: A transport placard as a responder sees it on a tank car or truck: a diamond in the hazard class color with the class number, a hazard word and the four-digit UN number. The class number and the hazard word are always printed, so the placard reads without color. This is an exercise representation, not a regulatory placard.

unNumber.description: Four-digit UN or NA identification number shown on the placard or orange panel.

hazardWord.description: Hazard word printed on the placard, such as CORROSIVE or FLAMMABLE.

caption.description: Where the placard was seen, for the inject.
examples: Placard on the east side of the tank car, photographed by the first engine company
